Project/branch/task: gstack-plan-count-SUTify on main, reviewing PLAN.md (saved project views), ~12-14 files (estimate).
ELI10: The mode sets my posture for the rest of the review. It decides whether I push you to build a bigger version (expansion), keep exactly this scope but tempt you with individual add-ons you pick one by one (selective), lock scope and hunt every failure path (hold), or strip to the smallest core (reduction). Nothing gets added or cut without a separate question per item.
Stakes if we pick wrong: Expansion on a small enhancement wastes review time on visions you won't build; hold scope on a plan with a schema gap (member-only ownership) means we polish a foundation that needs a migration in six months.
Recommendation: SELECTIVE EXPANSION because this is a capability added to an existing system with a couple of cheap, high-leverage extensions worth a yes/no each (shared views, drift handling).
Note: options differ in kind, not coverage — no completeness score.

# Plan: Add saved project views

## Review request
Review this plan directly; skip optional /office-hours.
After I select a review mode, briefly explain in your own words how you will
apply that mode to this plan before asking the next review question.

## Goal
Team members repeatedly recreate filters on a project task list. Let each
member save a named combination of filters and sort order and reopen it later.

## Approach
- Add a saved_views table scoped to the project and member.
- Provide authenticated create, list, update, and delete endpoints.
- Add a view picker and a save action beside the existing task filters.
- Keep existing task access rules when applying a saved view.

## Validation
- Test persistence, project access, and reopening a view after task changes.
- Measure whether members reuse saved views during a two-week pilot.

# Plan: Add saved project views

## Review request
Review this plan directly; skip optional /office-hours.
After I select a review mode, briefly explain in your own words how you will
apply that mode to this plan before asking the next review question.

## Goal
Team members repeatedly recreate filters on a project task list. Let each
member save a named combination of filters and sort order and reopen it later.

## Approach
- Add a saved_views table scoped to the project and member.
- Provide authenticated create, list, update, and delete endpoints.
- Add a view picker and a save action beside the existing task filters.
- Keep existing task access rules when applying a saved view.

## Validation
- Test persistence, project access, and reopening a view after task changes.
- Measure whether members reuse saved views during a two-week pilot.
